mod.name: item.seed.desc
Reduction Fern: A pinch of downy spores. They take root in a water-poor hydroponic tray, and the mature fronds store a pale teal reducing agent in their veins.

mod.name: item.seed.flavor
Reduction Fern: It doesn't mind the water. It minds the power.

mod.name: item.fronds.desc
Reduction Fern: A handful of grey-green fronds. Crushed, they seep reducing agent - one of the few legal sources for Nomore synthesis.

mod.name: item.fronds.flavor
Reduction Fern: It doesn't mind the water. It minds the power.

mod.name: upgrade.desc
Reduction Fern: Request a Reduction Fern through the agricultural network. Two spores arrive at once; grow them in a hydroponic tray and harvest fronds rich in reducing agent.
